posts.caption: AF3.2 on one page, 15 October 2026
posts.comment:
VISUAL FIRST: AF3.2 on one page. Backfilled under the rule that every ticket carries a visual and a document.

One page, landscape, built from the same data module as the document so a number on it cannot drift from a number in the document.

The one line worth reading: "217" is not reproducible by any filter. The fleet was exactly 217 for about EIGHT MILLISECONDS.

posts.caption: AF3.2 Agent count reconciliation, 15 October 2026
